# Example figure

```{python}
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

x = np.linspace(-1,5,200)
y = (x-2)**2 + 3

plt.figure(figsize=(6,4))
plt.plot(x,y)
plt.grid(True)
plt.xlabel("x")
plt.ylabel("f(x)")
plt.title(r"$f(x)=(x-2)^2+3$")
plt.show()
```
